updates.note: Management stated expectation of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores for OSAT for the year, lower than previous INR 1,500 crores minimum target for FY28.
updates.quote: OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

updates.note: Management stated PCB expectation of INR300 crores to INR400 crores for the year, lower than previous INR 1,000 crores minimum target.
updates.quote: a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores

new_promises.statement: OSAT Unit 2 is to be in commercialization by Q2 FY26.
new_promises.quote: Unit 1 is fully operational, and Unit 2 is in commercialization by Q2 '26.
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

new_promises.statement: Expect to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30 percent of total revenue.
new_promises.quote: our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.
new_promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar

new_promises.statement: Expect rail business to grow by around 20 to 25 percent this year.
new_promises.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in.
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
